extracted.name: My Country Style Steak
extracted.description: A simple and easy recipe for cube steak that can easily be stretched to feed as many as you like. Serve over rice or potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound cube steak, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 (1 ounce) envelope dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Dredge steak pieces in 1/2 cup flour to coat; shake off excess. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; add steak pieces. Cook until browned on all sides and some juices in skillet. Transfer to a plate using a slotted spoon; set aside.

Whisk soup mix and remaining 1 tablespoon flour together in a bowl; sprinkle into skillet. Cook and stir over medium heat until starts to brown. Gradually stir in water; return steak to skillet and season with salt, pepper, and garlic salt. Cover, and simmer over low heat for about 1 hour.
